questions.question: Which of the following lines divides the Earth into the Northern and Southern Hemispheres?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Equator is an imaginary line at 0° latitude dividing the Earth into Northern and Southern Hemispheres.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
भूमध्य रेखा 0° अक्षांश पर एक काल्पनिक रेखा है, जो पृथ्वी को उत्तरी और दक्षिणी गोलार्ध में विभाजित करती है।

questions.question: Which of the following is the smallest ocean?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Arctic Ocean, surrounding the North Pole, is the smallest and shallowest.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
आर्कटिक महासागर, जो उत्तरी ध्रुव के चारों ओर है, सबसे छोटा और उथला है।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about volcanoes is correct?

options.a: They are formed mainly at convergent and divergent boundaries
options.b: They are absent along plate margins

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Volcanoes form mostly at convergent and divergent plate boundaries where magma reaches the surface.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
ज्वालामुखी मुख्यतः अभिसारी और अपसारी सीमाओं पर बनते हैं, जहाँ मैग्मा सतह पर पहुँचता है।

questions.question: Which ocean is named after a country?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Indian Ocean is named after India.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
हिंद महासागर का नाम भारत के नाम पर रखा गया है।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about the Earth's core is correct?

options.a: The outer core is solid and the inner core is liquid.
options.b: The outer core is liquid and the inner core is solid.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The outer core is molten iron and nickel, while the inner core is solid due to immense pressure.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
बाहरी कोर लोहा-निकल का द्रव रूप है, जबकि अत्यधिक दाब के कारण आंतरिक कोर ठोस होता है।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about igneous rocks is correct?

options.a: They form from the cooling of magma or lava.
options.b: They are formed by sediment deposition.
options.c: They are formed only under water.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Igneous rocks originate from the solidification of magma or lava.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
आग्नेय चट्टानें मैग्मा या लावा के ठोस होने से बनती हैं।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about sedimentary rocks:
 (a) They form by compaction and cementation of sediments.
 (b) They are layered in structure.
 (c) They are crystalline in texture.
 Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Sedimentary rocks are formed by compression and are usually layered, not crystalline.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
आवसादी चट्टानें तलछट के दाब से बनती हैं और परतदार होती हैं, क्रिस्टलीय नहीं।

questions.question: Which of the following is a metamorphic rock?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Slate forms from shale under heat and pressure.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
स्लेट शेल के ऊष्मा और दाब से कायांतरण से बनता है।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about plate tectonics is correct?

options.a: The Earth's crust is divided into several large and small plates.
options.b: These plates float over the rigid mantle.
options.c: Plates move due to convection currents in the mantle.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Tectonic plates move due to mantle convection, forming the basic concept of plate tectonics.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
मेंटल में संवहन धाराओं के कारण प्लेटों की गति होती है, यही प्लेट विवर्तनिकी का मूल सिद्धांत है।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about longitude is correct?

options.a: Longitude lines are parallel to each other.
options.c: Longitude measures east–west distance from the Prime Meridian.
options.d: Longitude has no impact on time zones.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Longitude measures angular distance east or west of the Prime Meridian.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
देशांतर प्रधान लाभांश से पूर्व या पश्चिम की कोणीय दूरी मापता है।

questions.question: Which of the following continents has the highest average elevation?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Antarctica’s thick ice sheet gives it the highest mean elevation among continents.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अंटार्कटिका की मोटी हिम-चादर इसे सबसे ऊँचा महाद्वीप बनाती है।

questions.question: Which type of volcano erupts most frequently but mildly?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Shield volcanoes have gentle eruptions with low-viscosity lava.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
शील्ड ज्वालामुखियों में कम गाढ़े लावा से हल्के विस्फोट होते हैं।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about volcanic activity is correct?

options.a: Volcanoes are formed only on land.
options.b: Many volcanoes are found under oceans.
options.c: Volcanoes form due to water erosion.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Submarine volcanoes are common, forming islands like Hawaii.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
समुद्र के नीचे अनेक ज्वालामुखी सक्रिय हैं, जैसे हवाई द्वीप।

questions.question: Which line marks the southernmost point where the Sun can be directly overhead?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Tropic of Capricorn (23.5° S) is the southernmost latitude where the Sun can be overhead.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
मकर रेखा (23.5° दक्षिण) वह दक्षिणी अक्षांश है जहाँ सूर्य सीधे ऊपर होता है।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about the Kuiper Belt is correct?

options.b: It is the main source of asteroids.
options.d: It is located between Mars and Jupiter.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Kuiper Belt is a region beyond Neptune containing icy bodies and dwarf planets.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
कुईपर बेल्ट नेप्च्यून के परे एक क्षेत्र है, जिसमें बर्फीले पिंड और बौने ग्रह होते हैं।

questions.question: The Mid-Atlantic Ridge is associated with which process?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The ridge marks a divergent boundary where new oceanic crust forms.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
यह एक अपसारी सीमा है जहाँ नई महासागरीय पर्पटी बनती है।

questions.question: Which of the following is the largest planet in the Solar System?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Jupiter is the largest planet in the Solar System, with a diameter of about 142,984 km.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
बृहस्पति सौर मंडल का सबसे बड़ा ग्रह है, जिसकी व्यास लगभग 1,42,984 किमी है।

questions.question: The Pacific Ring of Fire is associated with which phenomenon?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Ring of Fire is a tectonically active belt of volcanoes and quakes.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
रिंग ऑफ फायर ज्वालामुखी और भूकंप की अत्यधिक सक्रिय क्षेत्रीय पट्टी है।

questions.question: Which of the following continents has the longest coastline?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Asia’s indented coastline is the longest among all continents.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
एशिया की गहराई लिए तटरेखा सबसे लंबी है।

questions.question: Which line marks the northernmost point where the Sun can be directly overhead?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Tropic of Cancer (23.5° N) is the northernmost latitude where the Sun can be directly overhead.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
कर्क रेखा (23.5° उत्तर) वह उत्तरी अक्षांश है जहाँ सूर्य सीधे ऊपर दिखाई देता है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about Earth's crust:
(a) It is composed mainly of iron and nickel.
(b) It is the outermost layer of the Earth.
(c) Oceanic crust is denser than continental crust.
 Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The crust is the outermost layer, with oceanic crust denser than continental crust; iron and nickel dominate the core, not crust.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
भू-पर्पटी पृथ्वी की सबसे बाहरी परत है; महासागरीय पर्पटी महाद्वीपीय से अधिक घनी होती है, जबकि लोहा और निकल कोर में पाए जाते हैं।

questions.question: Which continent has the highest number of active volcanoes?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Indonesia alone has around 55 active volcanoes, and Japan has about 40 active volcanoes as of 2025. This makes Asia the leading continent in terms of active volcanic activity.Indonesia

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
में लगभग 55 सक्रिय ज्वालामुखी हैं, और जापान में लगभग 40 सक्रिय ज्वालामुखी हैं, जो 2025 तक की स्थिति है। इससे एशिया महाद्वीप सक्रिय ज्वालामुखी गतिविधि के मामले में अग्रणी है।

questions.question: Which ocean is the deepest?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Mariana Trench in the Pacific is the deepest point on Earth.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
प्रशांत महासागर में स्थित मारियाना गर्त पृथ्वी का सबसे गहरा बिंदु है।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about longitude is correct?

options.a: Longitude lines converge at the poles.
options.b: Longitude lines are parallel like latitude lines.
options.c: Longitude does not affect local time.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Longitude lines converge at the poles, unlike latitude lines which are parallel.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
देशांतर रेखाएँ ध्रुवों पर मिलती हैं, जबकि अक्षांश रेखाएँ समानांतर होती हैं।

questions.question: The Himalayan mountain range is an example of which type of plate boundary?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Himalayas formed by the collision of the Indian and Eurasian plates at a convergent boundary.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
हिमालय का निर्माण भारतीय और यूरेशियन प्लेटों के अभिसरण से हुआ।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about mid-ocean ridges is correct?

options.a: They are formed at transform boundaries.
options.b: They are regions of plate collision.
options.c: They are associated with subduction zones.
options.d: They are formed at divergent plate boundaries.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Mid-ocean ridges form at divergent boundaries where new crust is created.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
मध्य महासागरीय पर्वत अपसारी सीमाओं पर बनते हैं जहाँ नई पर्पटी बनती है।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about the Moon is correct?

options.b: Its gravity is the same as Earth’s.
options.d: It completes one rotation in 12 hours.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Moon has a negligible atmosphere, so it cannot support weather.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
चंद्रमा का वायुमंडल नगण्य है, इसलिए यह मौसम का समर्थन नहीं कर सकता।

questions.question: Which of the following is a cold ocean current?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Canary Current, off northwest Africa, is cold.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
कैनेरी धारा उत्तर-पश्चिम अफ्रीका के तट के पास बहने वाली ठंडी धारा है।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about the Equator is correct?

options.a: It passes through South America, Africa, and Asia.
options.b: It is the longest line of latitude.
options.c: All locations on it have equal day and night all year.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Equator passes through multiple continents, is the longest latitude line, and has equal day and night year-round.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
भूमध्य रेखा कई महाद्वीपों से गुजरती है, सबसे लंबी अक्षांश रेखा है और पूरे वर्ष दिन और रात बराबर होती है।

questions.question: Which of the following planets is known as the Red Planet?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Mars is called the Red Planet due to the iron oxide on its surface giving it a reddish appearance.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
मंगल को लाल ग्रह इसलिए कहा जाता है क्योंकि इसकी सतह पर लौह ऑक्साइड होने के कारण यह लाल रंग का दिखाई देता है।

questions.question: The Mohorovičić discontinuity separates which two layers of the Earth?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Moho discontinuity separates the crust from the mantle.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
मोहो असंततता भू-पर्पटी और मेंटल के बीच की सीमा है।

questions.question: Which planet has a retrograde rotation?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Venus rotates in the opposite direction to most planets, called retrograde rotation.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
शुक्र अधिकांश ग्रहों के विपरीत दिशा में घूमता है, जिसे उल्टा घूर्णन कहा जाता है।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about Pluto is correct?

options.b: It is the ninth planet in the Solar System.
options.c: It has a solid surface covered with liquid oceans.
options.d: It is considered a dwarf planet.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Pluto is classified as a dwarf planet by the IAU.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
प्लूटो को IAU द्वारा बौना ग्रह के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया गया है।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about continents is correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Asia is the largest and Australia the smallest continent.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
एशिया सबसे बड़ा और ऑस्ट्रेलिया सबसे छोटा महाद्वीप है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about Saturn’s rings:
(a) They are made of ice and rock particles.
(b) They were discovered by Galileo Galilei.
(c) They are permanent and unchanging.
 Which statements are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Saturn’s rings are made of ice and rock; Galileo first observed them, but they are not permanent and change over time.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
शनि के छल्ले बर्फ और चट्टानी कणों से बने हैं; गैलीलियो ने इन्हें पहली बार देखा था, लेकिन ये स्थायी नहीं हैं।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about the Antarctic Circle is correct?

options.a: It lies at approximately 66.5° S latitude.
options.b: Inside this circle, the Sun never rises in summer.
options.d: It coincides with the Tropic of Capricorn.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Antarctic Circle is at 66.5° S; during polar night, the Sun remains below the horizon.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अंटार्कटिक वृत्त 66.5° दक्षिण पर स्थित है; ध्रुवीय रात में सूर्य क्षितिज से नीचे रहता है।

questions.question: Which scale measures the magnitude of earthquakes?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Richter scale measures the energy released by an earthquake.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
रिक्टर पैमाना भूकंप द्वारा छोड़ी गई ऊर्जा को मापता है।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about the Earth’s hemispheres is correct?

options.a: The Tropic of Cancer divides the Earth into Eastern and Western Hemispheres.
options.b: The Prime Meridian divides the Earth into Northern and Southern Hemispheres.
options.c: The Equator divides the Earth into Northern and Southern Hemispheres.
options.d: Longitude divides the Earth into Northern and Southern Hemispheres.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Equator divides the Earth into Northern and Southern Hemispheres.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
भूमध्य रेखा पृथ्वी को उत्तरी और दक्षिणी गोलार्ध में विभाजित करती है।

questions.question: Which ocean has the highest salinity on average?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Atlantic has high salinity due to strong evaporation and limited inflow.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अटलांटिक महासागर में उच्च वाष्पीकरण और सीमित मीठे जल के कारण लवणता अधिक है।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about the rock cycle is correct?

options.a: It describes transformation among all three rock types.
options.b: It involves only igneous and sedimentary rocks.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The rock cycle explains how igneous, sedimentary, and metamorphic rocks transform into each other.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
शैल चक्र आग्नेय, आवसादी और कायांतरित शैलों के परस्पर परिवर्तन को दर्शाता है।

questions.question: Which of the following is the largest ocean on Earth?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Pacific Ocean covers about one-third of Earth’s surface area.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
प्रशांत महासागर पृथ्वी की सतह का लगभग एक-तिहाई भाग घेरता है।

questions.question: Which of the following ocean currents is warm?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Gulf Stream carries warm water from the Gulf of Mexico toward Europe.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
गल्फ स्ट्रीम मैक्सिको की खाड़ी से यूरोप की ओर गर्म जल प्रवाहित करती है।

questions.question: Which rock is metamorphic in nature?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Marble forms when limestone undergoes metamorphism under heat and pressure.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
संगमरमर चूना पत्थर के ऊष्मा और दाब में कायांतरण से बनता है।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about isostasy is correct?

options.a: It explains the gravitational balance of Earth's crust.
options.b: It is related to ocean currents.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Isostasy explains how Earth's crust maintains gravitational equilibrium over the denser mantle.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
आइसोस्टेसी बताता है कि पृथ्वी की पर्पटी घने मेंटल पर गुरुत्वीय संतुलन कैसे बनाए रखती है।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about latitude is correct?

options.a: Latitude lines are vertical lines running from pole to pole.
options.b: Latitude lines measure distance north or south of the Equator.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Latitude lines are horizontal and measure north–south distance from the Equator.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अक्षांश रेखाएँ क्षैतिज होती हैं और भूमध्य रेखा से उत्तर-दक्षिण दूरी मापती हैं।

questions.question: Which of the following planets has the most moons?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Saturn currently has the highest known number of moons, over 275.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
शनि के वर्तमान में ज्ञात सबसे अधिक चंद्रमा हैं, 275 से अधिक।

questions.question: Which ocean current keeps the western coast of Europe warm?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The warm Gulf Stream moderates Europe’s western climate.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
गल्फ स्ट्रीम यूरोप के पश्चिमी भाग को गर्म बनाए रखती है।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about sedimentary rocks is correct?

options.a: They form by solidification of magma.
options.c: They are formed deep inside the Earth.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Sedimentary rocks form from deposition and compression of sediments; fossils are common.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
आवसादी चट्टानें तलछट के जमाव और दाब से बनती हैं; इनमें जीवाश्म सामान्यतः पाए जाते हैं।

questions.question: Which of the following ocean currents is cold?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Peru Current flows northward along South America’s west coast carrying cold water.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
पेरू धारा दक्षिण अमेरिका के पश्चिमी तट के साथ ठंडा जल उत्तर की ओर ले जाती है।

questions.question: Which of the following continents is known as the ‘White Continent’?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Antarctica is called the White Continent due to its ice cover.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अंटार्कटिका अपनी बर्फीली सतह के कारण ‘श्वेत महाद्वीप’ कहलाता है।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about the Tropic of Capricorn is correct?

options.a: It passes through South America, Africa, and Australia.
options.c: It marks the northernmost point of the Sun’s overhead path.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Tropic of Capricorn (23.5° S) passes through South America, Africa, and Australia.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
मकर रेखा (23.5° दक्षिण) दक्षिण अमेरिका, अफ्रीका और ऑस्ट्रेलिया से गुजरती है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about the Sun:
(a) It is a G-type main-sequence star.
(b) Its energy is produced by nuclear fusion of hydrogen into helium.
(c) It is the largest star in the Milky Way.
 Which statements are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Sun is a G-type main-sequence star, producing energy through hydrogen fusion, but not the largest star in the Milky Way.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
सूर्य G-प्रकार का मुख्य अनुक्रम तारा है और हाइड्रोजन संलयन द्वारा ऊर्जा उत्पन्न करता है, लेकिन यह आकाशगंगा का सबसे बड़ा तारा नहीं है।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about seismic waves is correct?

options.b: S-waves can travel through both solids and liquids.
options.d: Surface waves travel faster than P-waves.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
P-waves (primary waves) are the fastest seismic waves and travel through both solids and liquids.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
P-तरंगें सबसे तेज़ होती हैं और ठोस तथा द्रव दोनों माध्यमों से गुजर सकती हैं।

questions.question: Which planet has the fastest rotation period in the Solar System?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Jupiter completes one rotation in about 10 hours, making it the fastest rotating planet.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
बृहस्पति लगभग 10 घंटे में एक बार घूर्णन करता है, जिससे यह सबसे तेज़ घूमने वाला ग्रह है।

questions.question: Which ocean separates Africa from Australia?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Indian Ocean lies between Africa and Australia.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
हिंद महासागर अफ्रीका और ऑस्ट्रेलिया के बीच स्थित है।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about the lithosphere is correct?

options.b: It includes both crust and uppermost mantle.
options.d: It does not include the crust.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The lithosphere consists of the crust and the rigid upper mantle forming tectonic plates.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
लिथोस्फीयर भू-पर्पटी और मेंटल के कठोर ऊपरी भाग से बना होता है, जो प्लेटों का निर्माण करता है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about the Arctic Circle:
(a) It lies at the Equator.
(b) Inside this circle, the Sun remains above the horizon for 24 hours in summer.
(c) It lies at approximately 66.5° N latitude.
 Which statements are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Arctic Circle is at 66.5° N, where summer sun stays above the horizon for 24 hours.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
आर्कटिक वृत्त 66.5° उत्तर पर स्थित है, जहाँ गर्मियों में सूर्य 24 घंटे ऊपर रहता है।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about comets is correct?

options.a: They are primarily composed of rock and metal.
options.b: They have highly elliptical orbits around the Sun.
options.c: They remain visible even without approaching the Sun.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Comets have highly elliptical orbits and develop tails when approaching the Sun.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
धूमकेतुओं की कक्षाएँ अत्यधिक दीर्घवृत्ताकार होती हैं और सूर्य के पास आने पर उनकी पूंछ बनती है।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about Mercury is correct?

options.a: It has a thick atmosphere rich in oxygen.
options.b: It is the closest planet to the Sun.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Mercury is the closest planet to the Sun and has a very thin atmosphere.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
बुध सूर्य के सबसे निकट ग्रह है और इसका वायुमंडल बहुत पतला है।

questions.question: Which of the following continents lies entirely in the Southern Hemisphere?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Australia lies completely south of the equator.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
ऑस्ट्रेलिया पूरी तरह भूमध्य रेखा के दक्षिण में स्थित है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about the Prime Meridian:
(a) It passes through Greenwich, England.
(b) It is at 0° longitude.
(c) It divides the Earth into the Eastern and Western Hemispheres.
 Which statements are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Prime Meridian passes through Greenwich at 0° longitude and divides the Earth into Eastern and Western Hemispheres.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
प्रधान लाभांश ग्रीनविच से 0° देशांतर पर गुजरती है और पृथ्वी को पूर्वी और पश्चिमी गोलार्ध में विभाजित करती है।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about the Tropic of Cancer is correct?

options.b: It marks the southernmost point of the Sun’s overhead path.
options.d: It passes through the North Pole.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Tropic of Cancer (23.5° N) passes through India.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
कर्क रेखा (23.5° उत्तर) भारत से गुजरती है।

questions.question: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Sandstone is formed by the compaction of sand particles—thus sedimentary.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
बलुआ पत्थर रेत कणों के संघनन से बनता है, इसलिए यह आवसादी है।

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of an igneous rock?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Basalt forms from cooling lava; it’s a primary igneous rock.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
बेसाल्ट लावा के ठंडा होने से बनती है और यह प्रमुख आग्नेय शिला है।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about time zones is correct?

options.a: Each time zone generally spans 15° of longitude.
options.b: All countries strictly follow exact 15° divisions.
options.c: Time zones are based on latitude.
options.d: The Prime Meridian is not related to time zones.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Time zones are approximately 15° apart in longitude, though actual borders may vary.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
समय क्षेत्र लगभग 15° देशांतर पर स्थित होते हैं, हालांकि वास्तविक सीमाएँ भिन्न हो सकती हैं।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about continental drift is correct?

options.a: Continents were once joined in Pangaea.
options.b: Continents have been fixed since formation.
options.c: The theory was proposed by Alfred Wegener.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Wegener proposed that continents drifted apart from Pangaea.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
वेगेनर ने प्रस्तावित किया कि सभी महाद्वीप पैंजिया से अलग हुए।

questions.question: Consider the following plate boundaries:

options.a: Divergent – Plates move toward each other
options.b: Convergent – Plates move away from each other
options.c: Transform – Plates slide past each other

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
At transform boundaries, plates slide horizontally past one another.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
ट्रांसफॉर्म सीमा पर प्लेटें एक-दूसरे के समानांतर खिसकती हैं।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about the International Date Line (IDL) is correct?

options.b: Crossing it eastward loses a day, westward gains a day.
options.d: It divides the Earth into Northern and Southern Hemispheres.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The International Date Line roughly follows the 180° longitude; eastward crossing subtracts a day, westward crossing adds a day.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अंतर्राष्ट्रीय तारीख रेखा लगभग 180° देशांतर पर स्थित है; इसे पूर्व की ओर पार करने पर एक दिन घटता है, पश्चिम की ओर पार करने पर जोड़ता है।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about earthquakes is correct?

options.b: They are caused by volcanic activity only.
options.c: They cannot occur in oceanic regions.
options.d: They occur mainly along plate boundaries.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Most earthquakes occur along plate boundaries due to the movement and collision of plates.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अधिकांश भूकंप प्लेट सीमाओं के साथ प्लेटों की गति और टकराव से होते हैं।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the asteroid belt:
(a) It lies between Mars and Jupiter.
(b) It contains millions of small rocky bodies.
(c) It is the origin of most comets in the Solar System.
 Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The asteroid belt lies between Mars and Jupiter and contains millions of rocky bodies, but it is not the main source of comets.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
एस्ट्रॉयड बेल्ट मंगल और बृहस्पति के बीच स्थित है और इसमें लाखों चट्टानी पिंड होते हैं, लेकिन यह अधिकांश धूमकेतुओं का मुख्य स्रोत नहीं है।

questions.question: Which type of boundary forms mid-ocean ridges?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Divergent boundaries form ridges where new oceanic crust is created.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अपसारी सीमाओं पर नई महासागरीय पर्पटी के निर्माण से पर्वत श्रृंखलाएँ बनती हैं।

questions.question: Which of the following is the correct sequence of Earth's internal layers from the surface to the centre?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Earth’s structure consists of crust, mantle, and core in order from the surface to the center.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
पृथ्वी की संरचना सतह से केंद्र की ओर क्रमशः भू-पर्पटी, मेंटल और कोर से बनी है।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about Neptune is correct?

options.a: It is the coldest planet in the Solar System.
options.b: It has a strong magnetic field and fast winds.
options.c: It is visible to the naked eye from Earth.
options.d: It is closer to the Sun than Uranus.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Neptune has a strong magnetic field and experiences the fastest winds in the Solar System.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
नेप्च्यून का मजबूत चुंबकीय क्षेत्र है और इसमें सौर मंडल की सबसे तेज़ हवाएँ चलती हैं।

questions.question: Which planet is called the Earth’s twin due to similar size and mass?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Venus is similar to Earth in size and mass, earning the nickname “Earth’s twin.”

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
शुक्र आकार और द्रव्यमान में पृथ्वी के समान है, इसलिए इसे “पृथ्वी का जुड़वां” कहा जाता है।

questions.question: Which of the following layers is responsible for the movement of tectonic plates?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The asthenosphere, a semi-molten layer beneath the lithosphere, allows plate movement.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
लिथोस्फीयर के नीचे स्थित अर्ध-द्रवित एस्थेनोस्फीयर परत प्लेटों की गति की अनुमति देती है।
